title: Export and restore a dashboard configuration
summary: A support team shares a weekly service dashboard with a colleague. The recipient needs the same filters, columns and thresholds, without copying account credentials.

title: Give an interactive artifact its own data package
summary: An analyst uses the same expense explorer each month. A colleague needs the November data, currency and saved view, without receiving a new copy of the application.

title: Package a small standalone HTML application
summary: A developer creates an HTML cost calculator with an AI coding assistant and wants another person to inspect the exact built application and its initial inputs.

title: Share a minimal bug reproduction
summary: Support reproduces an invoice rounding error and gives engineering a compact input, expected result and exact reproduction steps.

title: Resume work from an explicit agent checkpoint
summary: A research agent finishes extracting invoice totals. A second agent in another tool must verify them and write a report without repeating extraction.

title: Keep an exported chart editable
summary: An analyst shares a monthly revenue chart and wants a recipient to change the period or color while preserving the underlying values and recipe.

title: Review an exact version of an artifact
summary: A team reviews a pricing policy document. The reviewer must see the exact proposal, supporting calculations and comments tied to that revision.

title: Restore a small offline workspace
summary: A field worker takes a site inspection template, reference information and a draft report to a location without connectivity.

title: Distribute a versioned reference catalog
summary: A retail kiosk needs product descriptions and translated labels that can be updated independently of the kiosk application.

title: Load selected files through a router
summary: A web application has a shared entry and a reports module that is only needed when the user opens Reports. The experiment compares whole delivery with selective file loading.
